title: clawsub status exits non-zero when no provider is ready
prompt: Make `clawsub status` exit with code 1 when zero providers in the chain are both installed and authenticated. Currently it always exits 0. Add a unit test using a mock state with no ready providers.
acceptanceCriteria: clawsub status exits 0 when at least one provider is ready
clawsub status exits 1 when no providers are ready
unit test covers both exit-code paths without spawning real CLIs
no changes to the human-readable output format
